rows.statement: The hosted API is Python FastAPI with Pydantic models (422 bodies shaped {detail:[{loc,msg,type}]}, unknown fields rejected), Postgres 16 as the system of record, Redis for cache/arq jobs, RabbitMQ for the call queue, S3 for recordings.

coverage_gaps.feature: Speech-to-speech mode (OpenAI Realtime, Gemini Live) replacing the transcriber/LLM/synthesizer legs; barge-in there is the provider's acoustic VAD
Speculative LLM request on Deepgram Flux EagerEndOfTurn (threshold 0.5, EOT 0.7, 500 ms timeout), cancelled on TurnResumed; RealtimeTranscriber also eager
Web search tool (OpenAI Responses default gpt-5.4-mini, Firecrawl, Exa, Parallel), node-scopable, with a spoken pre-call message
end_call tool as the primary hangup mode (or node-scoped end_call on graph nodes) instead of the extra completion LLM call
Multi-agent routing by utterance embeddings (Snowflake arctic-embed-l, threshold 0.85) and an agent-switch tool with handoff messages
coverage_gaps.publicly_visible: partly: docs llms-full.txt line ~8407 ('Multi-agent routing'); the embedding router is code-only

coverage_gaps.feature: Language switching = parallel streaming LID recognizer (Sarvam or Soniox) + dedicated judge LLM (default claude-haiku-4-5 via LiteLLM, optional Bedrock ap-south-1), hedged duplicate request after 1.8 s, 6 s cap, speculative follow-up in the target language, pre-rendered handoff clips cached across calls, prompt padded past Haiku's 4,096-token cache minimum
coverage_gaps.publicly_visible: no: docs describe the behaviour ('language-switching engine decides turn by turn', llms-full.txt ~15070) but not the judge model, the LID leg or the hedging

coverage_gaps.feature: Self-hosted Hindi ASR: provider 'bolna' = RealtimeTranscriber, default model nemotron-asr-hi (NVIDIA Nemotron) over the OpenAI Realtime transcription protocol; provider 'bolna' LLM treated as self-hosted
coverage_gaps.publicly_visible: no: CT logs showed inference-mumbai/deepgram hosts (BI-26) but not what runs; 'nemotron' in docs refers only to Nebius LLMs

RAG runs in a separate closed rag-proxy-server; the engine queries it every turn with only the latest user message (similarity_threshold 0.0) and puts the result in a trailing message to keep a cacheable prefix
coverage_gaps.publicly_visible: partly: docs llms-full.txt ~21953 say the latest user message retrieves chunks; the separate service is code-only

coverage_gaps.feature: Engineering maturity: 175 test files / 2,072 test functions; HTTP/2 disabled because cancelled h2 streams leak on barge-in; per-provider reconnect caps

While the agent is speaking, a final transcript of N words or fewer (dashboard N=2) that is not an exact stop phrase is DISCARDED as a false interruption, so short Hindi replies such as 'haan ji', 'nahi', 'ruko' never reach the LLM
coverage_gaps.publicly_visible: partly: the docs describe the interruption threshold; that the words are dropped from the conversation is code-only
